csv_project_name: Utility Master Plan for Main Campus Infrastructure
csv_scope_of_work: The University of Oregon (the Owner ) is soliciting qualifications from UO retainer firms to enter into a retainer contract to provide an updated comprehensive Utility Master Plan (the Project ) for the distribution and delivery of steam, chilled water, MV electricity, and compressed air to campus buildings. This letter contains the information required to respond to this RFQ. I recognize the effort required to develop a submittal of this type and would like to thank you in advance for responding to this RFQ. The Utility Master Plan (UMP) should serve as a strategic roadmap, providing clear direction and actionable strategies to ensure reliable delivery of essential utility services to the campus. As the University continues to upgrade existing buildings, enhance delivery and efficiency, and expand infrastructure to accommodate future growth in alignment with the Capital Project and Campus Framework Vision Plans, the UMP will guide these efforts effectively.
